name: realize_toFormula
statement: L.BoundedFormula α n) (v : α ⊕ (Fin n) → M) : φ.toFormula.Realize v ↔ φ.Realize (v ∘ Sum.inl) (v ∘ Sum.inr)

name: realize_boundedFormula
statement: L.BoundedFormula α n) {v : α → M} {xs : Fin n → M} : φ.Realize (g ∘ v) (g ∘ xs) ↔ φ.Realize v xs

name: model_distinctConstantsTheory
statement: Type w} [L[[α]].Structure M] (s : Set α) : M ⊨ L.distinctConstantsTheory s ↔ Set.InjOn (fun i : α => (L.con i : M)) s
